name: Registries & Records
definition: Registries and records are core state infrastructure: land, business, licensing, certificates, and other authoritative datasets.
summary: Immutable or tamper-evident records of ownership and entitlements.

experiments.title: Georgia land registry pilot
experiments.description: Widely cited early government blockchain experiment for land title integrity.

references.label: Georgia land titling on blockchain (Bitfury / NAPR)
World Bank – property registries and digitalization

challenges: Legacy registries are often paper or siloed; interoperability and verification across borders are limited. Fraud persists where verification is weak.
opportunities: Tamper-evident registries and attestations can reduce fraud and support dispute resolution; open schemas and anchors enable cross-border recognition.
